Dr. Jennifer Clader, Director of Health, City of Stamfod, lights the first of four candles during the 19th Annual World AIDS Day commemoration interfaith service at First United Methodist Church in Stamford on Dec. 1, 2016. In conjunction with World AIDS Day 2016, 15 clergy gathered to lead a service of Remembrance, Awareness, Hope and Healing for people whose lives have been touched by HIV/AIDS.  The service, sponsored by AIDS Interfaith Stamford, brings together Protestant, Catholic, Islamic and Jewish clergy in a service designed to remember those who have died, and to offer hope and healing to people living with AIDS and HIV infection and those who love and care for them.
